STS2WD-REALTA_LEGACY.title: Legacy
STS2WD-REALTA_LEGACY.description: Not limited to one enchantment: can receive any number of enchantments, including the same one repeatedly.
STS2WD-REALTA_REFINE.title: Refine
STS2WD-REALTA_REFINE.description: Choose a card in your hand. For this combat, an Attack gains [gold]Sharp[/gold]; any other card gains [gold]Adroit[/gold]. A non-[gold]Legacy[/gold] card that is already enchanted cannot be chosen.
STS2WD-REALTA_GUARD.title: Guard
STS2WD-REALTA_GUARD.description: If no unexhausted [gold]Steel Guardian[/gold] exists, create one in your hand. Increase each Steel Guardian's [gold]Block[/gold], including exhausted cards. Temporary duplicates are excluded.
STS2WD-REALTA_SPELL.title: Spell
STS2WD-REALTA_SPELL.description: The bonus activates if you have no energy remaining immediately after paying this card's cost. All Spell cards Exhaust.
STS2WD-REALTA_MASTERWORK.title: Masterwork
STS2WD-REALTA_MASTERWORK.description: Repeat this card's effects and enchantment effects X times, based on energy spent. Counts as playing one card. At X=0, no effects activate.
STS2WD-REALTA_DUEL.title: Duel
STS2WD-REALTA_DUEL.description: The bonus activates if the target enemy has no debuffs.
STS2WD-REALTA_VALOR.title: Valor
STS2WD-REALTA_VALOR.description: The bonus activates if the target enemy has positive Strength or Block.
